title: Presheaf
description: JSON Schema for a presheaf — a contravariant functor F : C^op → D from a category C to a value-category D (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. III §2; Mac Lane & Moerdijk 1992 Ch. I §3). Classical presheaves are Set-valued (D = Set); the 561 corpus also uses DBiLat-valued presheaves (the predication-fiber-functor). Specializes functor by requiring contravariance and adding a value-category cell. Uses oneOf to discriminate Set-valued from category-valued presheaves.

value-category.description: The kind of value-category. set: classical Set-valued presheaves (the Yoneda-lemma case). category: D-valued presheaves for arbitrary D (e.g., the predication-fiber-functor with D = DBiLat).

specific-value-category.description: The specific category D that the presheaf takes values in. Required only for the category-valued branch.
